propositions: prepare_reclaim_backup.py must enumerate all live origin heads and tags at runtime, collapse annotated-tag peeled OIDs onto canonical refs, and record exact direct and peeled OIDs in a JSON manifest

The helper must create an off-repository bundle containing the old tickets tip and requested pin refs, verify bundle integrity, and confirm restoration produces exact matching OID maps without mutating remote refs

Partial/promisor clones must be refused before artifact creation with a fresh-unfiltered-clone remedy; pre-existing artifacts and output destinations inside registered worktrees or Git directories must be rejected without overwrite

The helper must isolate each invocation under a unique refs/reclaim-backup/ namespace, clean up only that namespace on success or caught failure, and leave no incomplete artifacts or refs after abnormal termination

Bundle and manifest paths must be created atomically outside the repository/Git directory/worktrees with SHA-256 checksums and byte sizes recorded; remote heads/tags snapshot must be byte-identical before and after execution
